$comment: The OpenCode plugin contract: the single source of truth for plugin types, the plugin.toml schema, the selene std, the API docs and the host's Rust decoders. Edit this file, then run `cargo run -p opencode-plugin-spec -- --write`. Type strings use Luau syntax; `integer` is a whole number (Luau `number`).

rules: A plugin names the contract it targets in plugin.toml: `contract = "1.0"`.

Minor versions (1.1, 1.2, …) only add: new optional properties on `ui.*` nodes and specs, new semantic tokens (each with a 1.0 fallback token), new services, methods, signals, contribution kinds and enum values. A plugin that targets 1.0 runs unchanged on every 1.x host.
A host runs a plugin whose contract has the same major version. When the plugin targets a newer minor version than the host, the host still loads it and logs one warning in the console.
Unknown optional keys in a `ui.*` props table or a spec table log one warning per key in the console and fall back to the default. They never raise an error.
A deprecated property, method or token carries `@deprecated` in opencode.d.luau and in the docs, and keeps working for the whole 1.x line. Only contract 2.0 can remove it.
Names never change meaning within a major version: a token, enum value or method keeps its behavior and its type.

types.name: IconName
types.doc: The name of one of the app's icons, such as `"circle-check"`, `file:<name>` for the type icon of a file so named, or `<plugin>:<name>` for an icon declared by another plugin. A plugin's own `icons/<name>.svg` files go by their file name and win over the app's wherever that plugin names an icon: its `ui.*` nodes and every icon field it hands the host (a settings page, composer pill, titlebar item, session panel tab, closed tab, launcher, mobile view, or code block action). Each is a sanitized SVG document whose `viewBox` (or `width` and `height`) frames safe vector geometry and optional SMIL animation elements (`animate`, `animateTransform`, `set`, held on frame 0 under reduced motion) drawn with `currentColor`. types.name: UiLayoutProps
types.doc: Size, spacing, position and accessibility: every `ui.*` node takes these. A props table frozen with `table.freeze` is decoded once and its node copied after that, so keep styles many nodes share in frozen tables made once (`local LABEL = table.freeze({ size = 13, color = "text-weak" })`). A node whose props are partly its own takes the frozen style first and a small table of its own props after it, laid over the style: `ui.row(ROW, { key = id, onPress = open }, children)`, `ui.text(words, LABEL, { color = ink })`, `ui.icon(name, ICON, { color = ink })`. Only those are decoded; a prop in both takes the second table's value.

fields.name: focusGroup
fields.doc: One Tab stop for the focusable controls inside, which the arrow keys move between, as a roving `tabindex` does: Up and Down with `role` `list`, `listbox`, `menu` or `tree`, Left and Right as well otherwise. Home and End go to the ends; a `list` or `tree` stops at its ends, the others wrap. In a `list`, `listbox`, `menu`, `tree` or `tablist`, typing moves to the first control whose label starts with it. Space presses the focused control, and in a list Return does too.

fields.name: keys

members.doc: Fires when a composer picker opens or closes, with the open picker kind or nil.

services.name: Office
services.doc: Office documents laid out and drawn by the host, each on a thread of its own.

members.name: OpenAsync
members.sig: (path: string, directory: string, kind: OfficeKind) -> OfficeFile
members.doc: Reads a file of the session's folder `directory` through the server and, when its bytes are a zip archive, opens and lays it out as `kind`.

members.name: Version
members.doc: Grows with every change its views draw: pages laid out, zoom, a sheet's frame. Read in a render, it redraws as it grows.

members.name: SetSheet
members.doc: Shows a workbook's sheet `index`, from 1.

members.name: Sheet
members.doc: The workbook's sheet on show, from 1: the one `Office:SetSheet` chose, or the one a link in the sheet went to. Reading it redraws the caller when it changes.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Releases it and ends its thread.

services.name: Updater
services.doc: The app's own updates (Desktop's `Updater` IPC). The host checks, downloads and verifies on its own schedule; a plugin draws where it stands and asks for a check or the install.

members.name: State
members.doc: Where it stands; nil when no updater runs in this build. Read in a render, it redraws as it moves.

members.name: CheckAsync
members.doc: Checks for a newer version now, joining a check already running, and resumes with the state the check settled on: `up-to-date`, `ready`, `download-required`, `error`, or the work under way.

members.name: InstallAsync
members.doc: Restarts into the ready version, or opens a required download's page: resumes with nil once it handed off (a restart then quits the app on its own), else why it could not.

members.name: StateChanged
members.doc: Fires with each new state.

services.name: Diagnostics
services.doc: Developer diagnostics. Local and beta builds only, except `Get` of an experiment and `HeapSnapshotAsync`; elsewhere the rest return nil.

members.name: Memory
members.doc: The process's memory counters.

members.name: Metrics
members.doc: A plugin's live costs. Defaults to this plugin.

members.name: Plugins
members.doc: The ids of the plugins running in this window, for a console's target.

members.name: Get
members.doc: A developer setting: an experiment (`sources.enabled` `"on"` or `"off"`, `sources.icons` `"site"` or `"letters"`), the animation clock (`speed` a number, `slow` a boolean), the tuning panel (`knobs` a boolean), or memory diagnostics (`memoryLog` `"off"`, `"on"`, or `"env"` when the environment turned them on for this launch), and the layout tools: `direction` (`"ltr"` or `"rtl"`, the window's layout direction) and `forceFocus` (a boolean: every control draws its keyboard focus ring). Read in a render, it redraws as the setting changes.

members.name: Set
members.doc: Changes a setting `Get` reads (`memoryLog` takes a boolean and keeps it across launches; `direction` overrides the language's direction for this launch, and setting the language's own direction drops the override), or opens a developer tool: `components` the components lab.

members.name: HeapSnapshotAsync
members.doc: Captures heap snapshots in a new folder in the downloads folder: the app's own server's snapshot, where the memory is per process (`memory.json`), and `manifest.json`, written last. `path` is the folder; `error` says why nothing was captured, or which snapshot failed. Every build offers it.

services.name: Power
services.doc: Display sleep.

members.name: KeepAwake
members.doc: Keeps the display awake until the lock is released or the plugin goes away.

services.name: Qr
services.doc: QR codes.

members.name: Encode
members.doc: Encodes text as UTF-8 bytes at low error correction, in the smallest version that fits.

services.name: Askpass
services.doc: Credential prompts from child processes such as `ssh`.

members.name: Listen
members.doc: Starts a loopback prompt endpoint.

services.name: Images
services.doc: Images for `ui.image`: loaded from a source or handed over, decoded off the UI thread by the window's image cache (PNG and APNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, AVIF, ICNS and SVG).

members.name: Load
members.doc: The image at `src`, loading off the UI thread: an `https:` or `http:` URL, fetched as a browser loads an image (no credentials, 15 s, at most 8 MB); a path from `/`, read from the window's server with its sign-in (`/api/...`); a `data:` URL; or a file of the plugin's own folder by its relative path (`icons/logo.svg`). The same source is the same image, and its state is shared: one that failed fails again at once. `Images:State` says where it stands.

members.name: State
members.doc: Where the image stands. Read in a render, it redraws as the image lands or fails.

members.name: VideoFailed
members.doc: Whether the `ui.video` playing `src` can't play: its box then shows what's behind it. Read in a render, it redraws when the clip fails; a render memoized with `view:Memo` should put it in the memo's version, as with `Images:State`.

members.name: FromEncoded
members.doc: A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image, decoded off the UI thread. Nil when refused.

members.name: FromSvg
members.doc: An SVG image.

members.name: FromRgba
members.sig: (pixels: buffer, width: number, height: number) -> ImageId?
members.doc: Straight-alpha RGBA8 pixels.

members.name: Release
members.doc: Frees an image once nothing draws it.

services.name: I18n
services.doc: The plugin's own messages in the interface language, and numbers, dates and lists written the way the app writes them. A plugin's catalogs are `locales/<id>.json` in its folder: flat objects of message keys, the app's format.

members.name: T
members.doc: Message `key` in the interface language, else in `locales/en.json`, else the key itself. `{{name}}` placeholders take `args`, and a missing one reads empty. With a number `args.count`, the form `key.<category>` for the count's plural category is used when the catalog has it, else `key.other`, else `key`.

members.name: Has
members.doc: The interface language's catalog, or the English one, has message `key`.

members.name: Locale
members.doc: The interface language.

members.name: Direction
members.doc: Which way the interface language reads. Lay out rows from the reading start; the host mirrors its own layout.

members.name: Plural
members.doc: The plural category the interface language uses for `count`.

members.name: Number
members.doc: `value` with the language's digits, separators and signs.

members.name: Date
members.doc: The moment `ms` (milliseconds since the Unix epoch) in local time, in `style`.

members.name: RelativeTime
members.doc: A relative time: `-3, "day"` reads "3 days ago", `2, "hour"` "in 2 hours".

members.name: RelativeDay
members.doc: "today", "yesterday" or "tomorrow" for 0, -1 and 1 days from today, in the language. Nil for other days.

members.name: List
members.doc: Items joined as the language's long conjunction: "a, b, and c".

members.name: Changed
members.doc: Fires as the interface language changes. Everything drawn redraws on its own; connect for state you keep.

events.name: Disposing
events.doc: Fires as the half goes away: the plugin turns off, reloads, or its window closes. The host disconnects every connection afterwards.

events.name: FocusChanged
events.doc: Fires as the window gains or loses focus.

nodes.name: box
nodes.sig: ((props: UiBoxProps, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode) & ((style: UiBoxProps, props: UiBoxProps?, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode)
nodes.doc: A container with no direction of its own: children stack on top of each other.

nodes.name: row
nodes.sig: ((props: UiBoxProps, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode) & ((style: UiBoxProps, props: UiBoxProps?, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode)
nodes.doc: A horizontal stack.

nodes.name: col
nodes.sig: ((props: UiBoxProps, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode) & ((style: UiBoxProps, props: UiBoxProps?, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode)
nodes.doc: A vertical stack.

nodes.name: frame
nodes.sig: ((props: UiFrameProps, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode) & ((style: UiFrameProps, props: UiFrameProps?, children: { UiNode }?) -> UiNode)
nodes.doc: A layout container whose border takes room in layout, snapped to device pixels at every display scale as a CSS `border-box` border does.

nodes.name: spacer
nodes.doc: Flexible space in a stack.

nodes.name: divider
nodes.doc: A 1 px rule, laid out as a 1px CSS border is: one device pixel up to 1.5x, two at 2x. A box whose height counts its border holds it beside its content.

nodes.name: text
nodes.sig: ((content: string, props: UiTextProps?, ...string | number) -> UiNode) & ((content: string, style: UiTextProps, props: UiTextProps, ...string | number) -> UiNode)
nodes.doc: Text. Values after the props fill `{1}`, `{2}`... in `content`, written straight into the text: `ui.text("{1} / {2}", VALUE, read, write)`. Other braces stay as they are.

nodes.name: icon
nodes.sig: ((name: IconName, props: UiIconProps?) -> UiNode) & ((name: IconName, style: UiIconProps, props: UiIconProps) -> UiNode)
nodes.doc: One of the app's icons.

nodes.name: image
nodes.sig: ((props: UiImageProps, fallback: UiNode?) -> UiNode) & ((style: UiImageProps, props: UiImageProps, fallback: UiNode?) -> UiNode)
nodes.doc: An image the host holds, or loads from `src`. While it loads its box shows the `placeholder`; `fallback` takes its place when it fails (a site's letter in place of its icon).

nodes.name: video
nodes.doc: A video playing muted on a loop while it shows, as a page's `<video autoplay loop muted playsinline>`. Until its first frame, and if it can't play, its box shows what's behind it.

nodes.name: metric
nodes.doc: A number shown as text. Hosts that can animate changed digits do.

nodes.name: shimmer
nodes.doc: Text with the app's loading shimmer.

nodes.name: keybind
nodes.doc: A keyboard shortcut chip.

nodes.name: button
nodes.doc: The app's own button.

nodes.name: iconButton
nodes.doc: The app's own icon button.

nodes.name: switch
nodes.doc: The app's own switch.

nodes.name: checkbox
nodes.doc: Desktop's compact checkbox with its label.

nodes.name: radio
nodes.doc: A radio row.

nodes.name: field
nodes.doc: The app's own text field.

nodes.name: listbox
nodes.doc: A listbox container (`role="listbox"`) of selectable `ui.option` rows.

nodes.name: option
nodes.doc: One selectable option row (`role="option"`) inside a `ui.listbox`.

nodes.name: select
nodes.doc: Desktop's select dropdown control.

nodes.name: segmented
nodes.doc: The app's segmented control.

nodes.name: loader
nodes.doc: The app's spinner.

nodes.name: progressCircle
nodes.doc: The app's progress ring: a track and an arc from twelve o'clock, clockwise.

nodes.name: serverIndicator
nodes.doc: A server's health indicator, for a server source's row.

nodes.name: pill
nodes.doc: A status capsule.

nodes.name: badge
nodes.doc: Desktop's compact badge.

nodes.name: settingsRow
nodes.doc: A settings row: title and description beside a control.

nodes.name: settingsList
nodes.doc: A card of settings rows.

nodes.name: flyoutRow
nodes.doc: A popover row that opens a nested popover.

nodes.name: dialogHeader
nodes.doc: The app's dialog header: title, description and close button. Its close button closes this plugin's dialog, as Esc does.

nodes.name: markdown
nodes.doc: Markdown, as the timeline draws a reply.

nodes.doc: A long list that builds only its visible rows.

nodes.doc: An interactive UI outline, from a ```` ```ui ```` code block.

uiExtras.name: hex
uiExtras.doc: A literal color from `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`. Prefer a semantic token, which follows the theme.

uiExtras.name: each
uiExtras.sig: (items: { T }, key: string | ((item: T, index: number) -> string | number), version: string | ((item: T, index: number) -> MemoVersion), build: (item: T, index: number) -> UiNode) -> { UiNode }
uiExtras.doc: A node for each item, as children to pass on: `build(item, index)`, memoized per item as `view:Memo` is, by its key and version. A render builds again only the items whose version changed. `key` and `version` are field names (`"id"`) or functions of the item. An item's key becomes its node's key, so keep keys unique in the render. Put everything the row draws with, the theme among it, in its version.

pluginModule.name: contract
pluginModule.doc: The contract version the host implements, such as `"1.0"`.

pluginModule.name: defineWindow
pluginModule.doc: Defines the window half: `setup` runs once per window. Return the result from `init.luau`.

pluginModule.name: defineApp
pluginModule.doc: Defines the app half: `setup` runs once per process, before any window half. Return the result from `app.luau`.

globals.name: task
globals.doc: Cooperative scheduling on the host's frame clock. Waiting costs no CPU.

members.name: spawn
members.doc: Runs a function or thread now, until it first yields.

members.name: defer
members.doc: Runs a function or thread at the end of the current handler or event batch, before the frame commits.

members.name: delay
members.sig: (seconds: number, callback: ((A...) -> R...) | thread, A...) -> thread
members.doc: Runs a function or thread after `seconds`.

members.name: wait
members.doc: Yields for `seconds`, or until the next frame without it. Returns the seconds that passed. Not allowed in a render.

members.name: cancel
members.doc: Cancels a scheduled or waiting thread and its pending request.

globals.name: warn
globals.doc: Writes a warning to the console.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The plugin's id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It prefixes commands (`<id>.<command>`) and contracts.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: The plugin's own version, as semver.

fields.name: contract
fields.doc: The contract version the plugin targets, such as `"1.0"`.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: One sentence about what the plugin adds.

fields.name: entry
fields.doc: The window half's module, relative to the plugin folder.

fields.name: app
fields.doc: The app half's module, such as `"app.luau"`. Omit it for a plugin with no app half.

fields.name: os
fields.doc: The platforms it runs on. Omit it for all.

fields.name: channels
fields.doc: The app channels it loads in. Omit it for all.

fields.name: stores
fields.doc: The stores it uses, by name and scope. Every store of a plugin is in memory before its setup runs, declared or not; the list documents them.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: One value for the app, or one per session.

fields.name: settings_search
fields.doc: Settings search entries found without loading the plugin.

fields.name: page
fields.doc: The page: `plugins`, a host page, or one of this plugin's settings pages.
